Privacy Policy

Established: August 4, 2026

Last revised: August 5, 2026

1. Operator

Sole Proprietor (Business name: Kokoro Mimamori)　Naohisa Aoki

2. Input and registration on this site

  • The site does not provide an input form.
  • The site does not provide sign-in or account registration.
  • The site does not ask you to enter or submit a name, email address, street address, or similar information.

3. Features and services not used

  • The site does not use AI, external APIs, web search, automated collection, RSS, crawling, or scraping.
  • The site does not use advertising, affiliate marketing, or analytics tools.
  • The site does not use cookies or localStorage.

4. Temporary text-size storage (sessionStorage)

  • The site stores only standard or large to keep your selected text size while you move between pages in the same tab.
  • It does not store organization names, browsing history, URLs, search terms, or personal information.
  • It does not send the saved value to a server or external service, and does not retain it after the tab is closed.
  • If the browser's sessionStorage feature (temporary storage that keeps data only while the same tab remains open) is unavailable, the site displays the standard text size.

5. External sites

  • Destinations of public institutions and related organizations, the contact page, and the operator profile are external sites.
  • The destination's privacy policy and other terms apply after leaving this site. This site does not control information collected or stored by an external site.

6. Contact

  • This site does not provide a contact form and instead links to an external portfolio contact page.
  • The external page's privacy policy applies there.

7. Hosting and technical information

  • This site is hosted on GitHub Pages. The hosting provider may process technical information required for delivery, such as IP addresses, user agents, and access times.
  • The operator has not added independent analytics, advertising, or tracking.

8. Revisions

  • Changes to this policy will be announced on this page.
About this site

Helps users reach official information from public institutions and related organizations quickly.

  • This guide helps you find the responsible public institution or related organization by topic and continue to that organization's own official announcement.
  • It is not an official government website.
  • It is not a breaking-news service, news site, or fact-checking service.
  • It does not rate organizations or sources, or provide AI summaries or decisions.

Free to use. There are no ads or affiliate links, and no sign-in is required.

This is not an official government website, breaking-news service, or fact-checking service. Listing does not guarantee the overall reliability of an organization or the accuracy of information at a destination.

Before using this site
  • Listing does not recommend an organization as a whole or guarantee its reliability.
  • This site does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or currency of destination information. Check the organization's own official announcements directly for current information.
  • For evacuation and safety decisions during a disaster, follow the latest information from the relevant authorities.
  • Display order does not represent importance, reliability, accuracy, or recommendation. Destination groups and usage situations do not represent importance or urgency.
  • The destination site's policies apply after you leave this site.

Destinations are external official websites. Check the linked site for the latest information.
